scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test

scripts.db:migrate: turbo run build --filter=@hatti/db --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @hatti/db run db:migrate
scripts.dev:api: turbo run build --filter=@hatti/core --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @hatti/core run start:api
scripts.dev:worker: turbo run build --filter=@hatti/core --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @hatti/core run start:worker
scripts.seed: turbo run build --filter=@hatti/core --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @hatti/core run seed
